title: Appraisal Order Payment and Cancellation Terms
content:
**Payment and cancellation terms for Appraisal Order charges, by report type.**

1. *Timing of collection.* For every report type, appraisal charges may be collected only after the borrower's intent to proceed.
2. *Ways to pay.* For every report type, appraisal charges are accepted by debit card, credit card or ACH debit from the borrower's bank account.
3. *Cancellation fee after assignment.* When an assigned order is cancelled before inspection, the fee retained is the amount shown below for its report type, in US dollars.
4. *Cancellation share after inspection.* When an order is cancelled after inspection, the share of the appraisal fee retained is 100 percent for every report type.
5. *Refund timing.* An approved refund is issued within 5 business days for every report type.

| Report type | Collected only after intent to proceed | Accepted payment methods | Cancellation fee after assignment (USD) | Share of appraisal fee retained after inspection (percent) | Refund issued within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 75.00 | 100 | 5 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 100.00 | 100 | 5 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 100.00 | 100 | 5 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 100.00 | 100 | 5 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 100.00 | 100 | 5 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 150.00 | 100 | 5 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | Yes | debit card; credit card; ACH debit | 200.00 | 100 | 5 |

### Worked illustration (hypothetical)

An order of the Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) is cancelled after assignment and before inspection: the cancellation fee retained under item 3 is 150.00 dollars. The same order cancelled after inspection would see 100 percent of its appraisal fee retained under item 4.
